mentions.name: On-prem multi-region private cloud platform (KaaS/VMaaS)
mentions.description: An internal cloud platform built at the author's enterprise, providing totally on-premises, multi-AZ, multi-region Kubernetes-as-a-Service, VM-as-a-Service, and soon DBaaS, with all resources managed in a git-driven way to satisfy internal policies.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building the same thing at $enterprise, totally on-prem multi-AZ, multi-region KaaS, VMaaS, and soon DBaaS, and some of the other services listed.
